run_end2end_generator_training: run the Parlai end-to-end generator training loop on the wizard of wikipedia dataset with default hyperparameters
run_wizard_of_wikipedia_training: run the wizard of wikipedia generator training using the EndToEndAgent model with BPE tokenization
run_parlai_train_loop: run the Parlai TrainLoop with custom task and model arguments for dialogue generation training
run_generator_model_training: run training for a transformer-based dialogue generator model with fasttext embeddings and inverse sqrt learning rate scheduling
run_end2end_model_validation: run the end-to-end generator model training with perplexity-based validation and early stopping patience
